basics.name: Diego Quiñones
basics.headline: AI Automation Engineer
basics.label: Full-stack developer
basics.summary: I automate manual operations work with AI and ship it as a web tool: reports, documents and tickets that used to eat hours now run on their own. I come from IT support, so I automate what I have already seen break.
basics.lookingFor: Looking for a remote role where AI and automation are the job, not an experiment.

experience.summary: Night shift documenting and reporting the progress of a full plant shutdown, with compensated days every 14 days.
highlights: Replaced repetitive spreadsheets and reports with AI-assisted workflows the crew runs without knowing how to code.
Keep technical documentation current for crews and supervision across the whole shift.
Work 20:00–08:00 with daily deliverables and zero room for a wrong sheet number or date.

experience.summary: Help desk for 300+ users at a port company: hardware, Windows and office software.
highlights: Around 15 tickets a day: formatting, system imaging, Windows 11 upgrades and Microsoft Office.
Automated report and image generation with AI: batches that took about an hour dropped to under five minutes.
Mass cloning and device restoration without stopping operations.

certifications.name: EF SET English Certificate — C2 Proficient

projects.name: Panshulo Homelab
projects.description: Self-hosted server on a 7 GB ThinkPad: 15+ containers, no cloud hosting and everything behind a VPN. It is my real operations lab.
highlights: 15+ Docker services declared with Compose: media, *arr stack, Gitea and monitoring.
Access through Cloudflare Tunnel and Tailscale; UFW in default-deny mode on the host.
Custom Flask dashboard (psutil) plus Netdata, with health checks on systemd timers.
OS on NVMe and media on a USB HDD, with automount and a mixed pool.
projects.impact: Runs 24/7 on 7 GB of RAM with no hosting bill: remote access goes through a tunnel, not someone else’s servers.

projects.name: pdftoai
projects.description: CLI and REST API that turns large PDF, DOCX, XLSX and CSV files into agent-ready Markdown, with OCR fallback and semantic search.
highlights: PyMuPDF extraction with automatic Tesseract fallback when the PDF is scanned.
Heading detection by font size, YAML front matter with TOC and metadata.
Semantic chunking and vector indexing behind a search API.
Test suite over the API and a Docker image to run it anywhere.
projects.impact: Unifies native and scanned documents into a single pipeline with no manual steps.

projects.name: This portfolio
projects.description: The site you are reading: a bilingual Astro build with a three.js diorama and three graphics tiers that pick themselves.
highlights: Three tiers (no WebGL, medium, high) with auto-downgrade when frames drop.
Zero textures: the whole 3D scene is generated in code, CRT screen included.
Static ES/EN i18n with hreflang, a typed dictionary and a build-time sitemap.
CI on every PR, a performance budget and respect for prefers-reduced-motion.
projects.impact: The low tier never downloads three.js (126 kB gzip): a constrained device never pays that cost.
